title: Knock out TAGME with a two-guide deletion
label: Deletion between the two cuts
objectives: Choose a knockout strategy and two guides that flank the target.
Recognise wild-type, heterozygous, homozygous and compound-heterozygous clones from a Sanger trace.
Notice mosaic clones that must be re-cloned before expansion.
caveats: Teaching case built from a reference fixture in the Design repo's test suite; it is not annotated against ClinVar or any patient.
